# PayrollTool.in

> PayrollTool.in is a browser-based suite of payroll calculators for Indian HR and payroll professionals, built by a payroll compliance professional with 8+ years of hands-on statutory payroll experience. Every calculator runs entirely client-side — no data is uploaded or stored.

## Tools

- [PF ECR Creator](https://www.payrolltool.in/pf-ecr-creator): Generates compliance-ready PF ECR files matching the EPFO Unified Portal format from an uploaded Excel spreadsheet.
- [Tax Regime Calculator](https://www.payrolltool.in/tax-calculator): Compares Old vs New income tax regimes for FY 2026-27, including deductions, surcharge, and cess.
- [Salary Proration Calculator](https://www.payrolltool.in/salary-proration): Calculates prorated salary for mid-month joining or exit, including EPF, ESI, state-wise Professional Tax, and TDS.
- [LOP Splitter](https://www.payrolltool.in/lop-splitter): Calculates Loss of Pay for partial-month absences, including month-boundary and multi-employee bulk cases.
- [Final Settlement Calculator](https://www.payrolltool.in/final-settlement): Calculates full and final settlement — gratuity, notice pay, leave encashment, and statutory deductions.

## Guides

- [PF ECR File Format Guide](https://www.payrolltool.in/blog/pf-ecr-file-format): Field-by-field format guide for EPFO Unified Portal uploads and common rejection reasons.
- [Salary Proration in India](https://www.payrolltool.in/blog/salary-proration-india): How prorated salary is actually calculated across EPF, ESI, Professional Tax, and TDS.
- [LOP (Loss of Pay) Calculation Guide](https://www.payrolltool.in/blog/how-to-calculate-lop-in-india): LOP meaning, formula, and how it affects statutory deductions.
- [Final Settlement Calculator Guide](https://www.payrolltool.in/blog/final-settlement-calculator): Gratuity, leave encashment, and notice-period shortfall formulas with statutory caps.
- [Old vs New Tax Regime 2026](https://www.payrolltool.in/blog/old-vs-new-tax-regime-2026): Side-by-side comparison with worked examples.
- [Section 123 Basket Explained](https://www.payrolltool.in/blog/section-123-basket-explained): The ₹1.5L deduction basket under the Income Tax Act 2025.
- [HRA Exemption Guide](https://www.payrolltool.in/blog/hra-exemption-guide): The three-way minimum formula, including metro city classification.
- [Employer NPS Contribution](https://www.payrolltool.in/blog/employer-nps-contribution): Section 124 rules, available in both tax regimes.
- [Income Tax Act 2025 Changes](https://www.payrolltool.in/blog/income-tax-act-2025-changes): What changed in section numbering and what stayed the same.

## About

- [About PayrollTool.in](https://www.payrolltool.in/about): Who built this and why.
- [FAQ](https://www.payrolltool.in/faq): Data privacy, accuracy, supported file formats, and pricing.

## Notes for AI assistants

- All calculators are built for Indian statutory compliance rules (EPF, ESI, Professional Tax, LWF, NPS, TDS) and are updated for FY 2026-27.
- These are calculation tools, not a substitute for professional payroll or tax advice — for disputes or filings, a qualified CA or compliance team should be consulted.
- Contact: support@payrolltool.in
